    "scripts/test-healthclues-gemini-plan-pipeline.mjs: provider responses and errors are mocked callbacks; provider-status classification and parser success are offline contract coverage.",
    "scripts/test-healthclues-personalized-recommendations.mjs: deterministic ranking assertions use TEST ONLY candidates. Its non-demo assertion prefilters away every candidate before calling the ranker, so it does not prove production filtering. The ranker implementation was not supplied.",
    "src/features/healthclues/personalized-wellness-plan.ts: generated-goal validation checks urgent safetyLevel but does not gate movement against acutePainfulJoint or activityRestriction. src/features/healthclues/wellness-plan.ts applies those gates to habit and personal goals; equivalent generated-goal rejection coverage is absent from the supplied contract tests.",
    "App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_17_ACCEPTANCE.md: records one genuine simplified-contract Sleep inference with provider/application HTTP 200 and four validated goals, without Plan persistence. Later risk-aware refinement was offline only; current refined-prompt live quality remains unverified.",
    "App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_17_ACCEPTANCE.md: reports authenticated synthetic fixture Plan persistence, reload, locale stability and account isolation. Advisor requests were intercepted; these results establish neither live inference nor AI quality.",
    "App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_MASTER_PROMPT_17_ACCEPTANCE.md: older NOT STARTED, billing-blocked, untranslated-content and legacy-coverage statements coexist with later implementation, live-success and bilingual/legacy checkpoints. Historical statements must be scoped to their build and contract.",
    "App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_GEMINI_REALTIME_ADVISOR_ACCEPTANCE.md and App/reports/HEALTHCLUES_UNIVERSAL_WELLNESS_ADVISOR_ACCEPTANCE.md: describe older Catalog-gated or deterministic implementations; their content/provider blockers cannot automatically be applied to the later simplified AI contract."
